subject: outbackpools.com.au quick estimate calculator
body:
Hi there,

Was checking out your custom pool & spa builder projects in Sydney, your portfolio looks great.

Looked at your site on mobile and noticed there's a static contact form with no quick pricing guide, so visitors have to wait for a manual callback. In custom pool & spa builder, most homeowners want a fast ballpark in under a minute; otherwise they usually submit quote requests on 3 competitor sites instead.

I put together an interactive 60-second instant project estimator built specifically for Outback Pools that lets mobile visitors get a ballpark range and texts you their project details instantly. Mind if I send over a 20-second preview link to see how it looks?

Best,
Faiz Majeed
FZCORE Studio
